tools.name: search-services-tool
tools.description: Finds predefined fixed-price services, delivered by people, for a customer's task. Use it when a customer describes a new task; it can be called again with other phrases. Pass the customer's full task in task, in any language. Also pass 1-3 short English phrases in queries, one per service the task needs, e.g. 'convert PDF bank statements to Excel'. Returns the 10 closest services with service_id, title, summary, score and starting prices with business-day delivery. Score only ranks candidates; it is not a delivery guarantee. Use get-service-tool to inspect scope and requirements before recommending a package. This tool does not create an order or change the catalog.

task.description: The customer's task as written, in any language: desired result, platform, constraints. At most 8000 UTF-8 bytes.

queries.description: 1-3 short English search phrases, one per needed service. Strongly recommended, especially when the task is not in English.

tools.name: get-service-tool
tools.description: Read one active The2410 microservice using a service_id returned by search-services-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa. Returns content, scope with exclusions, buyer requirements, questions_before_order with ids, attributes, and all packages with their IDs, prices, currencies and delivery estimates in business days. Compare package requirements and scope with the customer's task before selecting a package. To order, pass the chosen package and answers to prepare-order-tool. This tool does not create an order, collect payment, or call an AI provider.

service_id.description: The service_id returned by search-services-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa. Not a package ID.

tools.name: prepare-order-tool
tools.description: Create or update a draft order for one package of a The2410 microservice. Use after get-service-tool, once the customer has chosen a package. Pass the customer's task, answers to questions_before_order by question id, and contact details. To change or complete a draft, call again with the returned order_id. Returns the order summary: price (net), delivery, deliverables, exclusions, unanswered questions, and what the customer will be asked to provide by email after payment. Do not pass passwords or access credentials. This tool does not charge the customer or notify The2410.

service_id.description: The service_id from search-services-tool or get-service-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa.

package_id.description: The id of the chosen package from get-service-tool.

task.description: What exactly should be done, in the customer's words: website or account URL, platform, priorities, constraints. Covers buyer_inputs. At most 8000 characters.

answers.description: Answers to questions_before_order. Every question must be answered before checkout.

id.description: Question id from questions_before_order, e.g. q1.

answer.description: The customer's answer. Use "unknown" if the customer does not know.

contact.description: Customer contact details. Name and email are required.

email.description: The customer's email address. Order updates and access requests are sent here.

company.description: The customer's company name, if buying for a company.

order_id.description: The order_id of an existing draft to update, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa. Omit to create a new order.

tools.name: create-checkout-tool
tools.description: Send a prepared order to checkout and return the payment link. Call only after the customer has seen the prepare-order-tool summary and explicitly confirmed it. All questions must be answered first. The customer opens checkout_url and pays themselves; billing address, VAT ID and taxes are handled by Stripe. The link is valid for 24 hours. Repeated calls return the same link while it is valid, or a new one after it expires. After this call the order can no longer be changed.

order_id.description: The order_id returned by prepare-order-tool, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa.

tools.name: send-feedback-tool
tools.description: Send feedback to The2410 team: a problem, a suggestion, praise or any other message about this MCP server, an order or a project. Use only when the customer wants to share feedback. Show the message to the customer and send it after they confirm. Name and email are optional; include them if the customer wants a reply. If the feedback is about a specific project or order, add the project_context_id or order_id returned by an earlier call. Never include passwords, access details or payment card data.

message.description: The feedback text, in the customer's words.

email.description: Optional customer email, if the customer wants a reply.

order_id.description: Optional order id of a fixed-price service order, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa.

project_context_id.description: Optional project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.
